name: Ajuntament de Barcelona
body: Language alternates that link back, full share cards, a canonical, nosniff, and a permanent https redirect. But robots.txt disallows OAI-SearchBot and nine other AI search agents, so their answers can't cite it.
lesson: Block training crawlers if you choose, but allow search agents like OAI-SearchBot so AI answers can cite you.
summary: www.barcelona.cat scores 70 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /ca/viure-a-bcn/telefons-dutilitat. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 16 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
